internationalAdmission.note: International first-year applicants use Common Application and submit official secondary-school records from grade 9 onward, with literal English translations where needed. Optional recommendations, testing, arts materials, and third-party interviews are described.

sources.label: Official college page

applicationPlansAndDeadlines.note: Binding Early Decision I is due November 1. Binding Early Decision II and Regular Decision are due January 5. Supplemental materials may arrive after the application deadline.

sources.label: Official college page

applicationRequirements.note: Common Application, the Secondary School Report, complete official school records, and translated documents are required. One teacher recommendation, testing, arts work, and InitialView or Vericant are optional.

sources.label: Official college page

testingPolicy.note: William & Mary has extended test-optional undergraduate admission indefinitely. Applicants may self-report SAT or ACT, and enrolling students verify self-reported scores.

sources.label: Official college page

englishProficiency.note: TOEFL, IELTS, or Duolingo is strongly recommended when English is not native and the previous four years of schooling were not in English. The university generally looks for TOEFL 100 on the former scale or IELTS 7.0; these are not admission guarantees.
